headlines.title: Brent crude tops $111 on Middle East worries as U.S., Israel reportedly weigh fresh Iran strikes
headlines.summary: This is the tape-mover of the morning — Brent at $111 with U.S. diplomats ordered out of Saudi Arabia and Iran strikes reportedly back on the table. Energy names catch a bid, airlines get crushed (four carriers already cut guidance this month), and the long bond rallies on haven demand while equities slide. When oil spikes on genuine supply-threat news, it touches every sector from consumer staples to industrials — this isn't noise, it's a regime shift.

headlines.title: Tech Slide and Oil Rally Spur Flight to Treasuries: Markets Wrap
headlines.summary: The whole risk-off cocktail is in one headline — tech earnings disappointing, oil ripping, and money flooding into Treasuries. This is the macro setup that sets the tone for every asset class: growth stocks under pressure, energy outperforming, credit spreads widening (see CoreWeave down 29% in October). When the broad market wraps look like this, the SPY is your primary instrument and every sector rotation trade is live.

headlines.title: US Midterm Elections 2026: What Results Could Mean for Wall Street
headlines.summary: Less than a month out and Wall Street is pricing in a Democratic House takeover — Bloomberg says stocks fall if both chambers flip, and the polling edge is real. This is a slow-burn catalyst that's already reshaping sector positioning: defense, energy, and financials face regulatory headwinds if the blue wave materializes. With Trump's economic approval at an all-time low per the CNBC survey dropping the same day, the political risk premium on equities is rising fast.
